description: This PHP class defines a validation rule for currency codes within the OrangeHRM project, specifically validating if a given input corresponds to a valid currency type. It utilizes dependency injection for service access and employs traits for auxiliary functions.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Validation rule class checking if an input string is a valid currency code (3-character string) and corresponds to a CurrencyType entity in the system.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the provided input is a string of length 3 that corresponds to a valid CurrencyType entity via the PayGradeService.
